title: Textile v1 Specification Schema
description: Exhaustive field definitions for a Textile Digital Product Passport. Covers India QCO (Quality Control Order), BIS textile standards (IS 17243, IS 16322), EU ESPR (Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation), ZDHC MRSL, and fiber traceability requirements.

material_profile.description: Human-readable material description — e.g. '100% organic cotton', '60% cotton / 40% polyester'

fiber_composition.description: Structured fiber breakdown by percentage — mandatory for EU ESPR fiber traceability and India fiber labeling rules

gsm.description: Grams per square meter — fabric weight/density. e.g. 180 for t-shirt jersey, 400 for denim

manufacturer.description: Primary manufacturer or CMT (Cut-Make-Trim) facility name

manufacturer_address.description: Physical address of the manufacturing facility

weight.description: Unit weight with measure — e.g. '250g per garment', '1.2kg per 10m roll'

lot_size.description: Production lot quantity — e.g. '500 units', '2000 meters'

carbon_footprint.description: Declared carbon footprint (legacy free-text). Use carbon_footprint_result for verified values.

country_of_origin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of final manufacture — e.g. IN, BD, VN, TR

fiber_origin.description: Country or region where raw fibers were sourced — e.g. 'India (cotton), China (polyester)'

production_stage.description: Current stage in the textile production chain

dye_process.description: Dyeing method used — affects chemical compliance and water/energy footprint

finish_type.description: Post-dyeing finishes applied — e.g. mercerized, brushed, peached, sanforized, wrinkle-resistant

color.description: Product color for traceability — e.g. 'navy heather', 'undyed natural'

dimensions.description: Size dimensions or roll width — e.g. 'width 150cm', 'S/M/L/XL'

water_usage_liters.description: Total water consumed per unit/kg — liters. India and EU both pushing for disclosure.

energy_usage_kwh.description: Total energy consumed per unit/kg — kWh. Covers spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing.

supplier_tier.description: Supply chain tier mapping — fiber supplier → mill → dye house → CMT

labor_compliance.description: Labor and social compliance certifications and audit results

chemical_compliance_zdhc.description: ZDHC MRSL (Manufacturing Restricted Substances List) compliance

zdhc_level.description: ZDHC MRSL Conformance Level — 3 is highest (full chemical inventory + testing)

restricted_substances_found.description: Any MRSL substances detected above threshold

dye_chemicals.description: Key dyes and chemicals used — for REACH/SVHC and ZDHC traceability

packaging_type.description: Packaging material — e.g. 'recycled paper box', 'biodegradable polybag', 'no plastic'

order_quantity.description: Total units in this production order

recycled_content_pct.description: Overall recycled fiber content percentage by mass (GRS / EU ESPR)

biodegradable_pct.description: Percentage of fibers that are biodegradable or compostable

expected_lifetime_washes.description: Expected number of wash cycles before significant degradation

eu_representative.description: EU Authorized Representative name or company (required for non-EU manufacturers)
